newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI SAYS UPS STAKE IN MTV TO 18.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI SAYS UPS STAKE IN MTV TO 18.5 PCT.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti Oy said on Wednesday that it had increased its ownership in television company MTV Oy to 18.5 percent.
"In the past year Aamulehti has bought 7,959 shares from the markets. Aamulehti now owns 10,192 MTV shares or 18.5 percent of shares," Aamulehti said in a statement.
Aamulehti said it had already earlier registered ownership of five percent, which according to MTV's articles of association is the maximum any one shareholder is entitled to register.
"The rest of the stake will not carry voting rights," an Aamulehti spokesman said.
At the end of 1995, Aamulehti held more than four percent of shares in MTV, he said.
Aamulehti CEO Matti Packalen said the MTV shares had been acquired in several transctions.
"MTV is an extremely well-managed company. The Aamulehti Group is working with MTV on several projects including a national commercial radio and a regional TV project," he said in the statement.
